text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So close... and yet so far.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My name's on the scoreboard... but that
just isn't
enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No, it can't be enough. Next time, I'll win for sure.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. And yes, I probably got
myself at
least a little attention today.
choice_data_list: 今日のレースも悪くなかった
有言実行を期待しているよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm counting on you to walk the talk.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But merely decent results will fade fast
from
people's memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A true super ultra mascot needs to draw
way,
wayyy more attention.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Just leave it to me. I'll show
everyone a run
they'll remember for as
long as they live.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, if I'm going to be the star of the
show next
race, I'd better get training.
And there's no time
like the present.
